answer: Weakest link is identity issuance: a sybil can mint cheap keys. Bind each agent to one onyx shard whose pigment pattern is burned into a shared grove ledger; every new key must consume a fresh shard and pay a verifiable burn fee. Spoof one key and you still cannot reuse the shard, so the grove rejects duplicates while burn cost scales linearly with clones. Breaking issuance only shifts cost to the attacker, not the economy.
